findings.claim: Advent 2026 begins Sunday, November 29, and that date falls on the LAST day of week 2026-11-23: the week is the final run-in to Advent, and its Sunday is the First Sunday of Advent (hope candle). Content for this week should close the 'gratitude turning to hope' bridge and land the first hope/watchfulness beats, saving Nativity material for December weeks.
findings.source: eClergys 'First Sunday of Advent 2026' (2026-10-06); Penned Grace 'Advent Candle Readings 2026: Scriptures for Each Week' (2026-11-04); Crosswalk 'First Sunday of Advent'

findings.claim: The first Advent candle's theme is HOPE and the liturgical Gospel for Advent week one is Mark 13:33-37 (watchfulness: 'Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is'); Advent writers frame waiting as ACTIVE waiting ('when we hope, we watch', 'prepare your heart'), not passivity.
findings.source: Care Net 'Advent Week One: When We Hope, We Watch' (2024-11-29); UMC.org 'Daily Advent devotions, week 1: Hope' (2024-11-20); American Bible Society 'An Advent Devotional Based on Readings from Mark'
